Definition: from G575 and G1658; one freed away, i.e. a freedman:--freeman.
BiblicalUsage: A freedman — the one called in the Lord while a slave is the Lord's freeman, just as the one called while free is Christ's servant. The word turns the world's ranks upside down in a single sentence.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Christ's freedom does not depend on my circumstances: called by him, I am free wherever I stand.
